scientific.integrity: The proof separately establishes domination and induced connectivity, isolates the unique disconnected two-by-two pattern, derives the generating polynomial by exact counting, and proves the inclusion-minimal classification. The packaged checker directly tests graph properties rather than reusing the symbolic criterion.
limitations: The theorem concerns the standard crown graph K_{n,n} with a fixed perfect matching deleted, for n at least 3.
The exhaustive checker covers n=3 through 9 only; the arbitrary-n claim rests on the symbolic proof.
Finite-instance graph databases can tabulate examples and an unindexed source under alternate crown notation may exist, so bibliographic residual risk is not zero.

title: All connected dominating sets of crown graphs
